mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND payment_status = 'pending'
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE payment_status = 'failed' AND created_at > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (tenant_id, order_number, customer_id, appointment_id, resource_id, resource_type, subtotal, tax_rate, tax_amount, tip_amount, tip_percentage, total_amount, payment_method, payment_status, order_status, notes, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{orderNumber}, #{customerId}, #{appointmentId}, #{resourceId}, #{resourceType}, #{subtotal}, #{taxRate}, #{taxAmount}, #{tipAmount}, #{tipPercentage}, #{totalAmount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentStatus}, #{orderStatus}, #{notes}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET subtotal = #{subtotal}, tax_rate = #{taxRate}, tax_amount = #{taxAmount}, tip_amount = #{tipAmount}, tip_percentage = #{tipPercentage}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, pos_terminal_id = #{posTerminalId}, transaction_id = #{transactionId}, card_last4 = #{cardLast4}, authorization_code = #{authorizationCode}, notes = #{notes}, refund_amount = #{refundAmount}, refund_reason = #{refundReason}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(created_at) = DATE(NOW()) ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(NOW()) AND MONTH(created_at) = MONTH(NOW()) ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT DATE(o.created_at) as statDate, COUNT(*) as totalOrders, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) as totalRevenue, COALESCE(SUM(o.tip_amount), 0) as totalTips, COALESCE(AVG(o.total_amount), 0) as avgOrderValue FROM orders o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(o.created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND o.payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY DATE(o.created_at) ORDER BY statDate

SELECT -- 客户满意度 (暂时返回固定值，后续可从appointments表获取) 4.5 as customerSatisfaction,
-- 服务完成率 (已完成订单 / 总订单) COALESCE( (COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)), 0 ) as serviceCompletionRate,
-- 预约取消率 (已取消订单 / 总订单) COALESCE( (COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)), 0 ) as appointmentCancellationRate,
-- 回头客率 (有多次订单的客户 / 总客户数) COALESCE( (COUNT(CASE WHEN customer_order_count.order_count > 1 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_order_count.customer_id), 0)), 0 ) as repeatCustomerRate FROM orders o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY customer_id ) customer_order_count ON o.customer_id = customer_order_count.customer_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(CONVERT_TZ(o.created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT statDate, resourceId, resourceType, resourceName, SUM(orderCount) as orderCount, SUM(totalRevenue) as totalRevenue, AVG(avgRating) as avgRating, SUM(ratingCount) as ratingCount, AVG(workingHours) as workingHours, AVG(efficiencyScore) as efficiencyScore FROM ( -- 获取所有资源的基础信息（即使没有订单） SELECT DATE(#{startDate}) as statDate, r.id as resourceId, r.type as resourceType, r.name as resourceName, 0 as orderCount, 0.0 as totalRevenue, 0.0 as avgRating, 0 as ratingCount, 0.0 as workingHours, 0.0 as efficiencyScore FROM resource r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE'
UNION ALL
-- 从订单表获取资源统计 SELECT DATE(o.created_at) as statDate, o.resource_id as resourceId, o.resource_type as resourceType, COALESCE(r.name, CASE WHEN o.resource_type = 'STAFF' THEN CONCAT('Staff Member ', o.resource_id) WHEN o.resource_type = 'ROOM' THEN CONCAT('Room ', o.resource_id) ELSE CONCAT('Resource ', o.resource_id) END ) as resourceName, COUNT(*) as orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) as totalRevenue, COALESCE(AVG(o.rating), 4.5) as avgRating, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.rating IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as ratingCount, 8.0 as workingHours, 85.0 as efficiencyScore FROM orders o LEFT JOIN resource r ON o.resource_id = r.id AND r.tenant_id = o.tenant_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(o.created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND o.resource_id IS NOT NULL AND o.payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY DATE(o.created_at), o.resource_id, o.resource_type, r.name
UNION ALL
-- 从预约表获取资源统计（包括员工和房间） SELECT DATE(a.appointment_date) as statDate, ar.resource_id as resourceId, ar.resource_type as resourceType, COALESCE(r.name, CASE WHEN ar.resource_type = 'STAFF' THEN CONCAT('Staff Member ', ar.resource_id) WHEN ar.resource_type = 'ROOM' THEN CONCAT('Room ', ar.resource_id) ELSE CONCAT('Resource ', ar.resource_id) END ) as resourceName, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) as orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(a.total_amount), 0) as totalRevenue, COALESCE(AVG(a.rating), 4.5) as avgRating, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.rating IS NOT NULL THEN a.id END) as ratingCount, 8.0 as workingHours, 85.0 as efficiencyScore FROM appointments a INNER JOIN appointment_resources ar ON a.id = ar.appointment_id LEFT JOIN resource r ON ar.resource_id = r.id AND r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(a.appointment_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND a.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY DATE(a.appointment_date), ar.resource_id, ar.resource_type, r.name ) combined_stats GROUP BY statDate, resourceId, resourceType, resourceName ORDER BY statDate, resourceId
